Samantha / Evan —

Thanks for the quick feedback. Answers and proposed commercial terms below — attaching a redline of the Azure marketplace commercial exhibit (Azure_PrivatePlan_Terms_redline.docx) and the SOW we discussed.

Commercial summary (proposed):
- List price: see SOW pricing table (attachment) — we can provide pricing bands for annual vs monthly commit.
- Billing cadence: Redwood can support monthly invoices to ClearHarbor (net-30) via a seller invoice flow; marketplace settlement is typically 30–45 days post-billing depending on Azure processing. If ClearHarbor requires monthly cashflow alignment, we recommend a monthly seller invoice with an agreed reconciliation cadence.
- Co-sell revenue share: proposed 70% ClearHarbor / 30% Redwood for co-sell-identified transactions processed through the marketplace listing. This is negotiable for committed ARR bands; we can model 75/25 for deals > $250k ARR.
- Entitlements & metering: entitlements will be validated via marketplace metering; we propose a 24-hour reconciliation window for usage disputes.
- Audit/compliance evidence: Redwood will provide SOC 2 Type II report and a data residency note confirming the Private Plan uses region-bound data processing in US West/East (we'll attach the attestation).

Open items for legal/procurement redline:
1) Invoice timing & payer flow — ClearHarbor preference for monthly net-30 (we can mirror).
2) SLA credits and uptime measurement in the marketplace exhibit.
3) Termination for convenience notice period — proposed 60 days.

Next steps:
- Please review the attached redline and SOW. If you agree with the commercial summary we will: 1) finalize the redline and 2) circulate to Redwood Legal for signature routing via DocuSign.

Happy to hop on a 30-minute call if you want to walk pricing and settlement timing.

--
Marissa Cole
Head of Marketplace Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
